text:
priya: onboarding AtlasEps-13B-int4 to canary. Repro: prefetch=true, batch=8, max_new_tokens=256. Seeing OOMs on node gpu-ml-12 with mem fragmentation. logs attached below.

sam: can you paste the oom stack / dmesg? also what's perf when it succeeds?

priya: here's the tail of the worker log:
```
[worker] Alloc failed for 1.2GB at step generation
KV cache alloc: 3.1GB used, free slots fragmented
Trace: alloc_block -> cudaMalloc -> out_of_memory
```
also perf: p50 latency 190ms, p95 780ms, but OOM spikes at 30% traffic.

mia: sounds like KV slot fragmentation after hot starts. Try KV compaction + reserve_slots=4 and lower max_new_tokens to 128 as a quick mitigation.

ashley: agree. Also reduce prefetch lookahead from 8 -> 3 and set batch_multiplier = auto to avoid big concurrent allocations.

priya: quick test change applied to canary config:
```
prefetch_lookahead: 3
reserve_kv_slots: 4
max_new_tokens: 128
batch_size: 6
```
restarting canary.

ops-bot: deploy initiated by priya on canary cluster 'ml-canary', id deploy-1767500000-01 :rocket:

sam: if that stabilizes we should follow with a slow ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2h windows and run quality eval against evalset-v1.

priya: after change: no OOMs for ~45min under test load (50qps), p95 down to 420ms. :relieved:

mia: good. We should also schedule a background job to run KV compaction on idle workers to avoid re-fragmentation. I'll open a PR for compaction cron.

ashley: can we add a metric to alert if fragmentation ratio > 0.6 ?

sam: yes, add alert 'kv_fragmentation_high' and tie to canary auto-rollback.

priya: plan: (1) merge compaction cron, (2) deploy canary config change to 25% for 2h, run evals, (3) if ok, 100% rollout and update defaults in model catalog to max_new_tokens=128 and prefetch_lookahead=3. Any objections? :eyes:

mia: +1

ashley: +1

sam: +1

priya: thanks team. I'll file the followups and link PRs here.

priya: followups: PR#4321 (compaction cron), PR#4322 (alert), IR#789 (canary result) -- will paste links after CI.
